## Decision

What decision or defect does this change address?

## Scope

What changed, and what intentionally did not change?

## Classification

- [ ] Patch: defect correction
- [ ] Minor: backward-compatible capability or control
- [ ] Major: assessment model, threshold, pathway, decision, or authority change

## Evidence

- [ ] Regression coverage added or the reason it is unnecessary is documented
- [ ] Governing versions and changelog updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Scope boundary and proprietary treatment preserved
- [ ] Rollback or containment path identified

## Release declaration

Merge only when the exact head passes both required checks, GitHub reports the
pull request mergeable, and all conversations are resolved. Protected
control-plane changes require a separate governance re-bootstrap.
